instruction.name: fldle.s
instruction.description: Floating-point bound-checked load, condition rj <= rk.

experiments.name: high-unroll load-to-ALU chain
experiments.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.w $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, -8; st.w $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r5, 0x7fffffffffffffff
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 21845 --iters 458 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 8; st.w $r4, $r20, 0; li.d $r4, -8; st.w $r4, $r20, 8; li.d $r5, 0x7fffffffffffffff' --asm 'fldle.s $f0, $r20, $r5; movfr2gr.s $r4, $f0; add.d $r20, $r20, $r4'

latencies.notes: 4 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. Unroll 21845, iters 458.

throughput.name: 8 independent addresses
throughput.asm: fldle.s $f0, $r21, $r30; fldle.s $f1, $r23, $r30; fldle.s $f2, $r24, $r30; fldle.s $f3, $r25, $r30; fldle.s $f4, $r26, $r30; fldle.s $f5, $r27, $r30; fldle.s $f6, $r28, $r30; fldle.s $f7, $r29, $r30
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; addi.d $r21, $r20, 0; addi.d $r23, $r20, 8; addi.d $r24, $r20, 16; addi.d $r25, $r20, 24; addi.d $r26, $r20, 32; addi.d $r27, $r20, 40; addi.d $r28, $r20, 48; addi.d $r29, $r20, 56; addi.d $r30, $r20, 1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4
